title: VAPO x AURO MIST 多场景眼部雾化仪系列设计
titleEn: VAPO x AURO MIST Multi-scenario Eye Nebulizer Series Design
subtitle: 校企合作个人项目-针对职场女性办公-通勤-居家三场景的设计
subtitleEn: Design for Working Women in Office-Commute-Home Scenarios
description: 聚焦职场女性长期屏幕用眼、环境干眼、睡前眼疲劳问题，打造模块化三合一眼部雾化护理产品，分桌面磁吸款、便携手持款、热敷眼罩款适配全日常场景。
descriptionEn: Modular three-in-one eye nebulizer relieving screen-induced eye fatigue for working women, including desktop, handheld and heating eye mask styles for full daily scenarios.
concept: 改良传统护眼仪器笨重噪音大、使用场景单一的缺陷，共用雾化核心模组，统一极简柔系外观材质，兼顾静音使用、人机舒适度与视觉美学，适配女性全天候护眼需求。
conceptEn: Optimized bulky, noisy and single-functional traditional eye care devices. Adopt shared core module and unified minimalist styling to meet women’s all-day eye care needs.
roleDetail: 独立完成项目痛点调研、方案创意、三款产品造型与人机优化，整合全套设计图纸，统一视觉规范并整理方案。
roleDetailEn: Finished pain point research, design ideation, ergonomic modeling, unified visual standard and complete design documentation independently.
